question: Which state has the lowest sex ratio as per the Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __** Haryana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

As per Census 2011, __Haryana __has the lowest sex ratio, i.e., the number of females per 1000 males.

 
• The sex ratio is a valuable source for identifying the female population in India and what is the ratio between women and men in India.
 
• It was revealed in the 2011 Population Census that the Indian population ratio 2011 is 943 females per 1000 males.
 
• Haryana has India's lowest sex ratio and the figure shows a number of 877 females to 1000 males.
 
• Puducherry and Kerala where there are more women than men.
 
• Kerala has India's highest sex ratio and the figure shows a number of 1084 females to 1000 males.
